limits: Requires a DashClaw workspace. The hosted trial at hosted.dashclaw.io is free, capped, and provisioned automatically on Google sign-in (18+). The OAuth consent screen binds each connection to one workspace; every tool call is limited to that workspace and recorded under the agent id "muse". Scopes: governance:read (decisions, approvals, policies, status) and governance:write (guard, record, plan, session, task, assumption tools). Approval decisions are made by a human in the DashClaw Approvals inbox, never by the connector. Self-hosted instances expose the same MCP endpoint at their own URL. Rate limits are fair use; sustained abuse gets HTTP 429.
extraNotes:
DashClaw is the approval layer for unattended AI agents. An agent declares what it is about to do, DashClaw evaluates the workspace's policies, and anything risky waits in a human Approvals inbox that the owner answers from a phone. Every decision is recorded in a signed ledger. With the DashClaw connector, Muse governs its own actions: it calls dashclaw_guard before a risky step, records the action, waits for the owner's approval, and the owner reviews the full history in DashClaw.

Technical notes for review:
- Hosted remote MCP server, Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST): https://hosted.dashclaw.io/api/mcp. In production today; the same server is published on npm as @dashclaw/mcp-server for stdio hosts.
- OAuth 2.1: authorization code + PKCE (S256), refresh tokens, Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591). Discovery: https://hosted.dashclaw.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and https://hosted.dashclaw.io/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Unauthenticated requests return 401 with WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata (RFC 9728).
- A workspace API key (oc_live_*) is also accepted as a Bearer token or in x-api-key.
- Tools (22): guard, record, invoke, wait_for_approval, decisions_recent, policies_list, capabilities_list, status, session_start/end/retro, plan_submit/status, task_create/update/event, assumption_record, pair, export_evidence, plus 3 resources. Full list: https://www.dashclaw.io/docs#mcp-tools
- Safety: the connector never performs the governed action itself; it evaluates, records and waits. Approval is a human click in DashClaw. There is no payment surface.
- A test workspace for end-to-end review is available on request from team@dashclaw.io.
